resources.string:
Thank you for using Tag Master! Here\'s what has changed since you last used the app:

Version 5.1.0
- Adds a setting to keep the screen on while viewing sheet music

Version 5.0.0
- Moves to a real-time backend for keeping your data up to date
- Adds support for more kinds of login
- Adds support for light/dark display modes
- Fixes a number of issues on modern versions of Android
- Adds an internal sheet music viewer so that external apps are no longer required. You can also press a button on this viewer to hear the key of the tag without leaving the music!
- Replaces email/sms sharing with the standard Android share sheet
- Adds direct opening of tags by ID

Version 4.0.1
- Minor bug fixes

Version 4.0.0
- Material redesign

Version 3.3.0
- Adds an adaptive icon

Version 3.2.3
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.2.2
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.2.1
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.2.0
- You can now use the return key to start a search!
- Fixes a number of issues with opening PDFs on newer devices
- Improves performance when opening sheet music
- Now uses a secure connection to BarbershopTags.com
- Other minor bug fixes

Version 3.1.0
- New material icon!

Version 3.0.7
- Fixes an occasional crash.

Version 3.0.6
- Uses cross-platform friendly URLs so you can share with Tag Master users on iOS and Windows Phone

Version 3.0.5
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.0.4
- Integrates native Facebook login (see the options menu to log in!)
- Enables hardware acceleration for UI
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.0.3
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.0.2
- Changes to allow inclusion in the Amazon Appstore.
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.0.1
- Minor bug fixes

Version 3.0
- Allows latest native UI to be used (including Honeycomb and Ice Cream Sandwich UI features such as the action bar)
- Now you can log in with Facebook to back up and synchronize your teachable and favorite tags in the cloud!
- Added a changelog
- Minor bug fixes
